clue.text: On one knee-that's the head all over!

parts.note: pate is an old word for the top of the head

indicators.note: over says the word all is turned round and read backwards

explanation.surface: Someone kneeling exclaims that their head is aching all over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns 'all' round to make LLA; the definition is loose, since the bone sits on the knee rather than defining it.
explanation.definitionFit: The kneecap is the small bone sitting at the front of each knee joint.

clue.text: It's the norm to cut the vegetable

parts.note: par is the standard or norm

explanation.surface: Trimming a vegetable is standard practice.
explanation.definitionFit: A pale root crop related to the carrot.

clue.text: Came to the point

parts.note: sounds like speaking frankly, but means narrowing physically to a tip

explanation.surface: Someone stopped waffling and spoke directly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something narrowing gradually ends in a sharp tip.

clue.text: Foreign capital in general has actually increased

indicators.note: in shows the answer lies within the run of words that follow

explanation.surface: Overseas investment has actually grown in general.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foreign capital' suggests money; it is a city. 'increased' only finishes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is the seat of government of Tibet.

clue.text: A craft worker with internal trouble-a belligerent man

indicators.note: with internal says something is placed inside the preceding letters

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, a kind of vessel
an ant is the standard worker of crosswords

explanation.surface: An artisan with an inner problem turns aggressive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'craft worker' looks like one artisan, but it splits into a steamship and the crossword's favourite insect, with 'with internal' slotting the trouble between them.
explanation.definitionFit: An attacker is someone who assaults another.

clue.text: Given a back seat

parts.note: reads as being demoted, but a seat strapped onto a horse's back is meant, also hinting at being burdened

explanation.surface: Someone pushed into a less important role.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider's seat is fitted on a horse's back, and to be lumbered with a burden is the same verb.

clue.text: Make a song about the Left, though shy

indicators.note: about means surrounding the letter that follows

parts.note: to sing is to make a song
L is the abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A timid person writes a song about the political left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shy' looks like timid; it is the verb to throw.
explanation.definitionFit: To fling or hurl is to toss something.

clue.text: Many hit back in wise fashion to express contempt

parts.note: DI is 501 in Roman numerals, a large number

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another
back turns the word for a blow round

parts.note: a rap is a sharp hit

explanation.surface: Many people retaliate cleverly when showing scorn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the hit round to PAR. 'Many' as 501 is a stretch of the usual D for 500; 'fashion' only finishes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To belittle is to show scorn for someone.

clue.text: Hint leg break should elicit cheer

indicators.note: break says the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A cricket hint about leg break bowling raises spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: A leg break is a type of spin delivery in cricket; here 'break' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To brighten someone's mood is to gladden them.

clue.text: The German admits hankering to be an excavator

indicators.note: admits means lets something in, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: der is the German for the

explanation.surface: A German man yearns to dig.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who digs trenches is a kind of digger.

clue.text: Repeatedly rings and cancels

definitions.meaning: rings the bells again, split as re- plus peals

explanation.surface: Bell-ringers ring again and again, and someone abolishes something.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two parts it means sounds the bells once more; as one word it means revokes legislation.

clue.text: Discernment in 24

parts.note: the answer to 24 down, meaning view

explanation.surface: Perception within a view.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 refers to 24 down, whose answer is SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep understanding or perceptiveness is what both words name.

clue.text: Grant Iran wanted-it could be telling

indicators.note: it could be suggests the preceding letters may form something else once rearranged

explanation.surface: A man called Grant wanted to visit Iran, which might make a good story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grant' looks like a verb or a name in the surface; it is simply fodder. 'wanted' is padding in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Recounting a story is a synonym of relating events in sequence.

clue.text: 17 across placing object in a church

indicators.note: in tells us one thing is placed inside another here

parts.note: it is a pronoun standing for any thing or object

explanation.surface: A character puts an item down inside a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 17 across is CHARACTER: the answer is the name of the letter H, a character of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The spelt-out name of the eighth letter is an example of a written symbol.

clue.text: Stuff concerning the chaplain

parts.note: to pad is to stuff or fill out

explanation.surface: Matters relating to the chaplain.
explanation.definitionFit: A military or forces clergyman is commonly called by this title.

clue.text: Do in the old head calling for total accuracy!

explanation.surface: Asking a former leader to act precisely.
explanation.walkthrough: NESS is a headland, as in Scottish place names.
explanation.definitionFit: Precision is the quality of being correct in every detail.

clue.text: Seat in bar possibly for the non-drinker

indicators.note: possibly signals that the words seat in bar may be arranged into another word

explanation.surface: Someone who doesn't drink takes a seat in a pub anyway.
explanation.definitionFit: A teetotaller refrains from alcohol, which is what the word describes.

clue.text: Small exercise can be damaging

explanation.surface: A little workout can cause injury.
explanation.definitionFit: Overstretching a muscle injures it.

clue.text: Figure maybe he's an eccentric

definitions.meaning: a figure such as a numeral or letter is a written symbol

explanation.surface: Perhaps a figure who is a bit of an oddball.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a written symbol like a digit and a quirky, unusual person.

clue.text: Wailed about a politician being so wrinkled

indicators.note: about says the first word surrounds the second

parts.note: MP is a member of parliament

explanation.surface: Someone sobbed over a politician who looked crumpled.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressed into small folds or ridges, as hair can be.

clue.text: Shellfish needs salt only

parts.note: an old salt is a sailor, AB being able seaman

explanation.surface: A shellfish dish needs only salt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'salt' looks like seasoning; it is a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: An edible sea mollusc with an ear-shaped shell.

clue.text: The name of a little aged gardener

indicators.note: a little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Asking what an elderly gardener is called.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little' picks out part of 'aged gardener'.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name is a name, so the clue defines it only loosely by type.

clue.text: Kindred may make men rage!

indicators.note: may make suggests the words can be turned into something else

explanation.surface: Being related could drive men into fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Related or relevant in nature is the old sense of the word.

clue.text: Note journos hold back

parts.note: re is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Reporters take notes but keep something to themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: To suppress or restrain is the meaning.

clue.text: Not fitting in a work-out?

parts.note: PT stands for physical training, a bout of exercise

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a gym session suits someone.
explanation.walkthrough: PT is physical training, the school name for exercise classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsuitable or inappropriate is the sense of the adjective.

clue.text: This security device features catch

explanation.surface: A gadget for security includes a catch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'features' looks like a verb meaning includes; it is a noun for parts of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap under the jaw holds a helmet securely in place.

clue.text: The physician presenting a dog to the monarch

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: The doctor gives a dog to the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who heals is a doctor.

clue.text: There's a great deal to view

definitions.meaning: a lot, as in a ... better

explanation.surface: A large amount there is to look at.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally it means a lot, and also a spectacle seen.

clue.text: A unit in support is to go in first

indicators.note: in says one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a pier is a supporting pillar

explanation.surface: A team member backing up others is to lead the way.
explanation.definitionFit: To blaze a trail is to be the first to do something.

clue.text: Tearing madly about for someone quite unappreciative

indicators.note: madly suggests the word tearing is thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Rushing about wildly because of a thankless person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madly' rearranges TEARING; 'about' is part of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who shows no gratitude is called this.

clue.text: A person ordering storage furniture

definitions.meaning: one who arranges or puts in order, as in dressing ranks or shop windows
a sideboard with shelves for dishes

explanation.surface: Someone sorting out cupboards.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sets things in line, and also a kitchen cabinet with shelves.

clue.text: Picks cockles

definitions.meaning: collects, as in picking up flowers
puckers or wrinkles, as fabric does

explanation.surface: Someone harvesting shellfish on the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Collects things up, and also draws cloth into puckers.
